create_rtdetr_resnet_backbone: create an RTDetrResNetBackbone instance with a configured RTDetrResNetConfig for image feature extraction
run_rtdetr_resnet_forward: run the RTDetrResNetBackbone forward pass on pixel values to extract multi-scale feature maps
build_rtdetr_resnet_stage: build an RTDetrResNetStage composed of stacked bottleneck or basic residual layers
test_rtdetr_resnet_embeddings: test the RTDetrResNetEmbeddings stem that converts input pixel values into deep convolutional embeddings
review_rtdetr_resnet_encoder: review the RTDetrResNetEncoder that processes embeddings through multiple stages and returns hidden states
